title: Ducker 16x
description: My own 16x pack for 1.8 based on ducks!

I was bored and started making a pack and this is the final product i think its kinda cool so check it out...


this pack features new textures for most of the 1.8 items like the ores, swords, tools and armour.

It's mostly a simplistic visually pleasing pack so you can play minecraft with some different and better looking textures
ENJOY!
